name: Tinker normal Spider Bomb damages a distant target (#5787)
contract: Original Build: Spider Bomb sends its device to the selected target and detonates. Drive the ordinary
500535 cast and its native twenty-yard pursuit, then require actual explosion dispatch, target damage
and device removal. Original Spider Bomb Explosion 801982 uses the magic hit table. Owner hit ratings
do not give the summoned device spell accuracy; a dispatched explosion can legitimately miss.
After the actual device appears, snapshot its native spell hit modifier and supply original Krosh Hit
Buff 2132158 to that owned creature. Its sole effect adds 100 percentage points of spell hit. Require
that exact native increase before judging target damage. Keep the original explosion, cooldown, target
selection and movement handlers; the accuracy fixture does not provide movement or explosion effects.
